name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran says two tankers hit mines at Hormuz; talks on a two-day reopening plan go on
state: Iran's IRGC said on 1 Nov that two tankers on an unauthorised route struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, after attacks on tankers on 30–31 Oct. Foreign minister Araghchi said talks with mediators on reopening the strait within two days were continuing if conditions are met, including lifting the US blockade. Trump said on 1 Nov Iran must make a deal.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to Iran; check its advice for Gulf states. Shipping should follow UKMTO guidance.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping; Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
